title: WordPress Audit
meta: A clear review of your WordPress site with a prioritized fix list and an optional 1-on-1 call. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WordPress audit with a prioritized fix list
overview: We review your WordPress site and give you a written report that shows what to fix first. We check speed, security, plugins and theme health, search basics, mobile layout, forms and broken links. Each finding says what is wrong, why it matters and how to fix it in plain words. Standard and Premium add a video call where we walk through the findings and answer your questions.

pkgs.blurb: A fast health check with a ranked list of the main issues.
Adds a security and search review plus a call to discuss.
A deeper review with a fix roadmap and a re-check after changes.

faq: Will you change anything on my site?
No. An audit is read-only, so nothing on your site is touched. You get the report and decide what to act on, and we can quote the fixes separately if you want them done.
Your site link is enough for the Basic review. For deeper checks we ask for an administrator user, which you can remove afterward. We never need your passwords.
Is the audit useful if my site is small?
Yes. Small sites often have the same issues, such as slow images, old plugins and missing search titles, and they are quick and cheap to fix.
Do you review the content itself?
We look at structure, headings, titles and clarity, not at the facts in your writing. Deeper content or copy work is a separate service we can quote.
